Waslوصل

Phase 1 — the lineage of the Prophet Muḥammad ﷺ back to Ādam, as it stands in the primary Arabic sources. Every name, every link and every second name below carries a quotation from a named critical edition, machine-checked against the text before this page was written. Where the sources disagree, every reading is kept and shown side by side.

Phases 2–5 widen the tree by parser: Quraysh under Fihr, the household of the Prophet, the Ṣaḥāba from the two companion dictionaries, and the Qaḥṭānī half down to al-Aws and al-Khazraj. Every quotation is still machine-checked against the page it cites. Nodes marked auto were placed by the chain parser: the quotation is verified, but the placement rests on the anchor being the right man.
